banner_headline: Parliament Adjourned Again As Prime Minister Naps On Budget

hero_photo.scene: A ginger cat in a tiny Nehru jacket asleep on a stack of budget papers while human clerks stand frozen around her in the Lok Sabha.
hero_photo.caption: PM Smt. Mithu Billoreji in the fourth hour of what her office calls 'fiscal deliberation'.
hero_photo.secret: Our photographer waited three hours for her to open one eye. She did, saw him, and closed it.

stories.headline: Budget 2025: Rs 40,000 Crore For Cardboard Boxes, Nil For Dogs
stories.text: Finance Minister Shri Whiskers Qureshi pushed the Union Budget off the table at 11:04 am, watched it fall, and declared it passed. Highlights include a national sunbeam subsidy, zero GST on malai, and a vacuum cleaner ban. The Opposition, three street cats from Itwara, walked out, then walked back in, then stood in the doorway.

photo.scene: A grey cat's paw pushing a red budget briefcase off the edge of a polished desk.
photo.caption: The Finance Minister tables, then un-tables, the budget.
photo.secret: This was the seventh briefcase. The first six are still under the desk.

stories.headline: New Market Bakery Strike Enters Day 9 Over Mandatory Fish Toast
stories.text: Bakers at Sharma Bun Bhandar, New Market, continue their strike against the Ministry of Snacks order that every loaf contain 30% rohu. 'My cream rolls smell like Upper Lake,' said owner Ramesh Sharma. Minister Fluffy Chouhan visited the picket line, sat on the placard reading 'No Fish In Pav', and refused to move.

photo.scene: A white Persian cat sitting on a protest placard outside a shuttered bakery while bakers look on helplessly.
photo.caption: Talks have stalled. So has the Minister.
photo.secret: The bakers were feeding her cream under the table the entire time.

stories.headline: Old Clerk Retires After 38 Years Of Opening The Same Door
stories.text: Babulal Yadav, 61, retired on Friday from Vallabh Bhavan, where his sole duty was opening a door for Secretary Chhotu, who never decided whether to go in or out. There was no farewell function. At 5 pm, Chhotu, now nineteen and nearly blind, climbed onto Babulal's scooter seat and would not get down. Babulal walked home.

photo.scene: An elderly man in a faded safari suit walking beside an old scooter with a thin tabby cat seated on it at dusk.
photo.caption: Babulal Yadav and Secretary Chhotu, leaving office together for the last time.
photo.secret: The scooter is still parked there. Babulal comes by every morning to check on the seat.

sports.headline: Laser Dot Remains Uncaught As Bhopal Billis Draw Indore Pouncers

classifieds: WANTED: Human with warm lap, steady income. No dog history. Apply to Joint Secretary Sardi, Arera Colony.
FOR SALE: Expensive cat bed, never used. Box it came in NOT for sale.
LOST: My dignity, when I fell off the almirah near Chowk Bazaar. If you saw it, you didn't.
letter_to_editor: Sir, I have written to my MP eleven times about the potholes on Hamidia Road. Each time, the letter is returned shredded, with one dead lizard attached. Is this a yes? — R. K. Saxena, Bhopal

cartoon.caption: "I will now take your questions. Actually, no."

popups.title: BREAKING: PM Awake
popups.text: Prime Minister Billoreji has woken up, stretched, and gone back to sleep on a different file. Markets steady.

popups.title: Sharma Bun Bhandar Fish Toast
popups.text: Now with 30% rohu, by law. We are so sorry. Available once the strike ends.

popups.title: Should the door be open or closed?
popups.text: The Cabinet has debated this since 1998. Cast your vote; it will be ignored.

popups.title: A Dog Writes In
popups.text: Sheru from Itwara says: 'I think the government is doing a great job! I love everyone!' He remains ineligible to vote.

premise: What if cats ran the government?
